title: Intolewd
lyrics:
[00:11.10]We took our trousers off, the socialists asleep
[00:16.76]We talked and talked for hours, it was really deep
[00:22.68]You're a kind of angel, dancing by the table
[00:28.34]I was doing fine then I met you
[00:42.44]I don't need a sign, what will be will be
[00:48.03]Let's go start a life somewhere in the weeds
[00:53.72]I am usually able, but your effect is fatal
[00:59.30]I was doing fine then I met you
[01:05.18]I was doing fine but then I met you
